_note: Planting plan for the hero garden: an asymmetrical English cottage garden. Positions are fractions of the scene (x left→right, y top→bottom); 'box' is [x0, y0, x1, y1] on the ground plane where the group sits. Heights are real-world metres. The left and right sides differ in plants, grouping, height and rhythm but balance as a whole: the left is soft pinks, blues and lime with tall spires at the back; the right is bold yellows, apricots and purples with silver herbs, anchored by the sunflower stand and the olive.
